dialogues.speaker: Shinnojou
dialogues.text: I flipped through some of my latest diary entries, and page after page is filled to the margins with sadness... You couldn't even tell that I was a positive guy on the up and up before. *sigh* This is no way to motivate oneself.

dialogues.speaker: Shinnojou
dialogues.text: I wonder, though... Would such tragic developments make for a good novel?

dialogues.speaker: Shinnojou
dialogues.text: You know, with the pauper lad unable in the end to win the hand of the fair, rich young lady...? Aha, ahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Shinnojou
dialogues.text: Maybe I might have a shot at getting published if I were to organize my internal journey into a novel...
